headline: One-sentence TLDR of the channel's current trajectory and the single biggest lever.

production.title: Finding actionable IN THIS REPO / by the skills: editing, clip selection & length, titles/packaging, publishing, funnel wiring (related videos, pinned comments, playlists), cadence
production.evidence: The specific numbers from channel-data.json that support it (name videos, cite views/impressions/CTR/retention).
production.recommendation: The concrete action to take in the next edit/clip/publish cycle.
production.status: done | partial | open  (optional — renders a checkmark chip; use on production items to track whether the fix has shipped)
production.status_note: optional — what was done / what remains, with commit or video references

recording.title: Finding actionable BY THE HOSTS while recording: episode structure, segment order and length, hooks, live bits, on-mic habits
recording.evidence: e.g. retention on Ep 4 drops from 7% to 4% at the 30% mark, which maps to segment X starting.
recording.recommendation: What to change in how the show is recorded.

experiments: Optional list of one-line A/B-style experiments; prefix [prod] or [rec] for ownership.
